package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// TechVersionRepoPG implements TechVersionRepository.
type TechVersionRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Create inserts tech version.
func (r TechVersionRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, version domain.TechVersion) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx,
		`INSERT INTO tech_version (tech_id, version, created_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3)`,
		version.TechID, version.Version, version.CreatedAt,
	)
	return mapPgError(err)
}

// GetByID finds tech version by id.
func (r TechVersionRepoPG) GetByID(ctx context.Context, id int) (*domain.TechVersion, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, tech_id, version, created_at FROM tech_version WHERE id=$1`, id)
	var tv domain.TechVersion
	if err := row.Scan(&tv.ID, &tv.TechID, &tv.Version, &tv.CreatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &tv, nil
}

// GetByTechAndVersion finds tech version by tech and version.
func (r TechVersionRepoPG) GetByTechAndVersion(ctx context.Context, techID int, version string) (*domain.TechVersion, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, tech_id, version, created_at FROM tech_version WHERE tech_id=$1 AND version=$2`, techID, version)
	var tv domain.TechVersion
	if err := row.Scan(&tv.ID, &tv.TechID, &tv.Version, &tv.CreatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &tv, nil
}

// Update updates tech version.
func (r TechVersionRepoPG) Update(ctx context.Context, version domain.TechVersion) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE tech_version SET version=$1 WHERE id=$2`, version.Version, version.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// Delete removes tech version by id.
func (r TechVersionRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM tech_version WHERE id=$1`, id)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// List returns tech version list with pagination.
func (r TechVersionRepoPG) List(ctx context.Context, filter filters.TechVersionFilters) ([]domain.TechVersion, int, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, limit, offset := filters.NormalizePagination(filter.Page, filter.Limit)

	where := ""
	args := []any{}
	argIdx := 1
	if filter.TechID != nil && *filter.TechID > 0 {
		where = "WHERE tech_id = $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx)
		args = append(args, *filter.TechID)
		argIdx++
	}
	if filter.Query != nil && *filter.Query != "" {
		cond := "version ILIKE $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx)
		if where == "" {
			where = "WHERE " + cond
		} else {
			where += " AND " + cond
		}
		args = append(args, "%"+*filter.Query+"%")
		argIdx++
	}

	var total int
	countQuery := "SELECT count(*) FROM tech_version " + where
	if err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, countQuery, args...).Scan(&total); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	query := "SELECT id, tech_id, version, created_at FROM tech_version " + where +
		" ORDER BY tech_id ASC, version ASC LIMIT $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + " OFFSET $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx+1)
	args = append(args, limit, offset)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var items []domain.TechVersion
	for rows.Next() {
		var tv domain.TechVersion
		if err := rows.Scan(&tv.ID, &tv.TechID, &tv.Version, &tv.CreatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		items = append(items, tv)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	return items, total, nil
}

var _ repository.TechVersionRepository = (*TechVersionRepoPG)(nil)
